name: Suwayomi Launcher
description: Zero-setup Tachiyomi/Mihon extensions for Seanime manga. Downloads and runs a portable Suwayomi-Server in the background, adds a "Mihon Extensions" page, and adds every installed source to the manga Source list.
author: oktavianto

networkAccess.reasoning: Talks to the local Suwayomi server (127.0.0.1:4567) and downloads Suwayomi-Server from its GitHub releases.

commandScopes.description: Run Suwayomi-Server with its bundled Java (Windows)
Run Suwayomi-Server with its bundled Java (Linux, macOS)
Run Suwayomi-Server with the system Java (other platforms)
Check the system Java version (other platforms)
